svg.title: Supplier–Buyer Agent Collaboration connectivity
svg.desc: Default: local browser and Python server on your own computer at localhost:8000. The VNet has separate APIM, Foundry Hosted and shared private-endpoint subnets. Optional Container Apps hosting adds its own delegated environment subnet for private ingress and VNet egress to APIM and private services. The internal environment requires no additional private endpoint. Managed services remain outside the VNet. APIM Internal with Credential Manager, private Foundry and Studio A2A are the proposed cloud topology, not completed migration evidence. The separate token-exchange panel is omitted for readability.

text.tspan: Run the app on your own computer | Container Apps hosting is optional
Move this same UI + backend to Azure
SAME REQUEST PATH / TWO HOSTING CHOICES
Local: Python requester on your computer
Optional: requester in the Container Apps subnet
VNET / THREE REQUIRED SUBNETS + ONE OPTIONAL CONTAINER APPS SUBNET
ACR registry and data endpoint zone
Private names resolve inside the VNet
Reuse private DNS and network access
Optional cloud path via VPN / ExpressRoute
Local and cloud hosts are alternatives.
Three required subnets + optional ACA subnet. Four PEs, with no additional ACA PE.
Logical product labels only. Responses return through the same chain. Azure private access does not make Copilot Studio or Entra private.
